name: application-column-mapping-rows
title: Column Mapping Rows
description: CSV/spreadsheet import field mapping rows: each source column with a sample value maps to a target-field dropdown, badged Auto or Manual, with a mapped-count summary and continue action.
useWhen: Building the field-mapping step of a CSV or spreadsheet import flow.
You need to show which mappings were auto-matched by heuristic versus which need manual review.
Distinct from Import Wizard, which is the multi-step container (upload, preview, map, confirm) that this mapping step would live inside, not the row-level mapping UI itself.
avoidWhen: You need the full multi-step import flow, not just the mapping step — compose this inside Import Wizard instead.
There's no auto-match heuristic to convey — a plain source/target pair list is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Each row uses a fixed three-column grid (source, arrow, target) so alignment holds regardless of source-column name length; the sample value truncates rather than wrapping.
accessibility: Each target dropdown carries an aria-label naming the source column it maps, since the visible label is shared as a column header rather than per-row.
Auto/Manual match status is conveyed via both a text badge and a border-color cue on rows needing manual review, never color alone.
The mapped-count summary is plain text, giving screen reader users the same completion signal sighted users get from the badges.

variants.title: Column Mapping Rows
variants.description: Three source columns (full_name, email_addr, notes_internal) mapped to target fields, two auto-matched and one requiring manual selection, with a mapped-count footer and Continue button.
accessibility: Manual-match rows get an amber border in addition to the badge text, not color alone.

variants.title: Column Mapping Rows (Dark)
variants.description: The same mapping rows adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Badge and border contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
